patch.value: View consented agent questions, context receipts and evidence gaps

Acceptance: a viewer cannot read another scope packet; revoked access invalidates future retrieval; UI and API show identical omission receipts. Provide typed SDK and CLI, bounded TOON/JSON, revision-bound explicit consent, remedies, Triplicate UI, docs and example, synthetic desktop/mobile evidence, public tracker read-only no-git validation, and npm/Bun CI gates. No inference, memory or new backend.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Overlap check: core SDK owns PmReadOutputSessionReceipt and PmReadOutputReceipt, cross-call accounting, suppression and output rendering. pm-context owns pack assembly and pm-context-usage/v1 receipts. Decision inbox covers Plan decisions, not scoped context. This feature adapts existing receipt metadata and uses the existing pm-web PostgreSQL store, with no inference, memory, or second backend. Scope authorization must be separate from generic tracker reads. Preserve pinned CLI 2026.10.19; no new core lease behavior is needed. Acceptance: deny other-scope packets, invalidate retrieval after revocation, and render identical API omission reasons/remedies in the UI.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Implemented scoped receipt metadata in the existing PostgreSQL store, with explicit audience consent, server-derived publisher identity, atomic revision replacement and deletion, and current project access checks. Native commands use authenticated HTTP and core TOON/JSON rendering; SDK adapters consume core output-session and pm-context public receipts. Six targeted real HTTP/SDK/native CLI regressions passed, including a no-git tracker with no git executable. Targeted new-server coverage: 100 percent statements, lines and functions; 89.74 percent branches. Synthetic browser acceptance passed at 1440 and 390 pixels: two receipt omissions and one gap match API text exactly, no horizontal overflow, and refreshing after revocation removes the question. Public validation: public main a11f58c, 176 certified items, 383 immutable source files, 11 returned bounded rows, 3 suppressed repeats, 1541 estimated source tokens within 1600, two receipt omissions, one gap, 660 packet JSON bytes, source hashes unchanged. Full npm and Bun release gates will run in CI to avoid saturating the shared host.

Keyed responses must recheck current route authorization and stored resource visibility at the common idempotency boundary, with an audit of every covered mutation family and regressions for context plus another route. value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Implemented the shared replay authorizer with an explicit 78-route inventory and drift regression. Every replay checks current principal/resource authority and never reexecutes the mutation. Opaque provider/extension-command/graph-query/presence responses fail closed with live-read remedies. Packet replay requires current project capability, publisher, audience and exact revision. Realtime content-free invalidation covers packet writes/deletion, direct/group project sharing, membership changes and account/project removal. Revoked project streams send a terminal access-revoked control frame before closing. Open views clear on signals, use a serialized ten-second fallback with a five-second read deadline, clear hidden-tab content and guard late responses. Targeted 106-test run passed; changed replay/access coverage measured 97.39 percent statements and lines, 83.33 percent branches, 100 percent functions. Both refreshed Triplicate screenshots were visually checked for the three requested nits. Six open-session browser revocations passed: audience, sharing and deletion, each through SSE and disconnected fallback.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Behavioral revert proofs (assertions/fixtures unchanged): removing only finishSettled's replay authorization block made both selected real-HTTP regressions fail (0 pass, 2 fail): context replay returned cached 201 instead of 404 after revision replacement, and PM create replay returned cached 201 instead of 403 after editor downgrade. Command: node scripts/with-test-db.ts node --test --test-name-pattern='keyed context publish cannot resurrect|another idempotent PM route refuses' test/idempotency-access.test.ts. Replacing only the view's invalidateAgentContext, revokeAgentContextView and scheduleValidation bodies with their previous no-op behavior, then rebuilding frontend, caused the unchanged local-server browser regression to fail waiting three seconds for the revoked state after deletion in an already open view. Exact source bytes were restored and frontend rebuilt. Positive restored runs cover all six SSE/disconnected audience/share/delete cases. Linked pm tests ran successfully: 7 plus 44 tests, 51 executions, no skips; project test-result tracking is disabled, so this comment preserves results without changing tracker configuration.
